study_type_evidence.quote: were intravenously injected SCD dissolved in sterile normal saline ... at a dose of 1.0 mg/kg through the tail vein

in_vivo_species.strain_sex_age: male db/db mice with T2D (BKS.Cg-m +/+ Leprdb/J); 10-week-old for acute study, 6-week-old for chronic study
in_vivo_species.quote: Male db/db mice with T2D (BKS·Cg-m +/+ Leprdb/J; they were purchased from Model Animal Research Center of Nanjing University)
eight male db/m mice of the same line (purchased from Model Animal Research Center of Nanjing University) acted as controls

in_vitro_detail: INS-1 rat insulinoma cells (proliferation, ROS, proinsulin mRNA, insulin secretion, insulin receptor expression, glucose uptake); human VPAC2/VPAC1/PAC1-transfected CHO cells (competition radioligand binding with [125I]PACAP38 and [125I]VIP, cAMP accumulation); cell-free in vitro release of DBAYL from SCD in RPMI 1640 medium supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum at 37 °C.

concentration_time_figure.locator: Fig. 2B (in vivo half-life); Fig. 2A (in vitro release vs time)
concentration_time_figure.caption_quote: (B) The half-life of BAY55-9837, DBAYL, Exendin-4 and SCD in db/db mice.
concentration_time_figure.note: Fig. 2B presents the in vivo half-life determination for the four agents in db/db mice; the body does not state the plotted units. Fig. 2A additionally plots cumulative in vitro release of DBAYL from SCD versus time (0-48 h) in RPMI 1640 with 10% fetal bovine serum.

bioanalytical_method: LC/MS/MS for in vivo blood concentrations; RP-HPLC (280 nm) for in vitro release, entrapment efficiency and drug loading; ELISA for insulin
bioanalytical_quote: the concentration of SCD was assayed by LC/MS/MS method described previously
notes: Half-life was calculated with a one-compartment elimination model in WinNonlin 5.1. The PK dose (1.0 mg/kg i.v.) differs from the pharmacodynamic dose (20 nmol/kg i.p.); animals per group and blood sampling n for the PK arm are not reported in the body. BAY55-9837, DBAYL and Exendin-4 were stated to be 'used for control' in the half-life study but their individual doses and routes for that study are not reported. The BAY55-9837 half-life of ~5 min appears only in the Introduction as a previously reported value; no numeric BAY55-9837 or Exendin-4 half-life measured in this study is printed in the body (only fold-differences). The in vitro release assay used RPMI 1640 medium supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum; this was a drug-release assay rather than a serum-stability assay, so it was classified as in vitro. Cmax and Tmax are not reported anywhere in the body.
